remarks: Contractors, investors, and visionaries-this is the opportunity you've been waiting for! Nestled in a highly desirable, walkable neighborhood, this 3-bedroom, 1-bath home is bursting with potential. With solid bones and a true blank canvas, this is your chance to restore, reimagine, and create a standout property that will be the envy of the block. Renovate and make it your dream home, or capitalize on a strong flip-either way, the upside is undeniable. The level backyard offers incredible potential to become a private outdoor oasis with the right touch. Bring your creativity and transform this property into something truly special. The buried oil tank will be removed prior to closing, and the home can be connected to city sewer lines in the street. Sale is subject to probate approval. Opportunities like this don't come around often-unlock the value and make your mark! Home being sold "As-Is".
